name: io.github.coriolislabs/walletcap
title: walletcap for Coinbase payments MCP
description: Spend limits for Coinbase's payments MCP: a per-payment cap and rolling 24h USDC budget per wallet

packageArguments.name: --wallet
packageArguments.description: The agent wallet's address. Create its budget first: npx walletcap set --wallet <address> --per-payment <dollars> --per-day <dollars>

packageArguments.name: --path
packageArguments.description: The budget file, when it isn't the default per-user file

packageArguments.name: --allow-tool
packageArguments.description: Let one more of the server's tools through, uncounted
